traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet imagination. Heightened artistic sensibility and romantic idealism. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Seeing what you want to see in love, idealizing others, and the disillusionment that follows. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for connection against imagination, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the connection/imagination form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.summary: A polished offer makes an uncertain agreement feel more secure than it is.
readerCopy.body: A polished offer makes an uncertain agreement feel more secure than it is. Beautiful images, warm assurances, or fast chemistry carry the plan forward while price, availability, commitment, or ownership remains unresolved. Venus makes the possibility desirable, while Neptune fills missing terms with hope and projection. The square keeps the attractive version colliding with details nobody wanted to make less romantic or less sellable. The offer may remain tempting even after people realize they were agreeing to different outcomes.
